title: Professional Certificate Course in The Roles Functions and Actions of Destination Management Organisations
description: This course aims to provide participants with the knowledge and skills necessary to navigate the dynamic landscape of destination management.
longDescription: Discuss the Historical Development of the Tourism and Hospitality Industry. Explain the Impact of Technological, Economic and Social Changes on the Development of the Tourism and Hospitality Industry. Assess the Contemporary Factors that will Affect the Future Development of the Tourism and Hospitality Industry. The Need for Destination Management. The Roles of Destination Management Organisations at National and Local Levels. The Common Issues Faced By Destination Management Organisations in a Tourist Destination. This Professional Certificate Course in The Roles, Functions and Actions of Destination Management Organisations provides a comprehensive overview of why destination management is essential, elucidating the roles of DMOs at both national and local levels. Participants will delve into common challenges faced by destination management organizations, gaining insights and skills crucial for effective destination planning and sustainable tourism practices.
